title: This is the most advanced robot hand ever invented #shorts
description:
This is the most advanced robot hand ever invented.

It’s the tendon-based NEO hand from 1X.

And it sounds wild to say…but this single innovation might just be the “ChatGPT moment for robotics.”

Now the big breakthrough here is that this hand has 25 degrees of freedom.

And that means it has nearly as much dexterity and strength as a human hand.

It can assemble legos, play video games using a controller, and is even delicate enough to change a lightbulb.

Which is wild.

Now when you look at the hand, you can see the super complex tendon based drive system.

But the real genius…and what makes this so insanely unique is that this is the first ever robot hand that can feel.

See all other robotic hands are basically numb.

The hand can’t feel what it’s touching, so cameras watch the hand move and try to guess what it’s feeling.

That’s why most robot hands look so clumsy and laggy when they pick stuff up.

They have no sense of touch.

But this hand from 1X is completely different.
Every one of the degrees of freedom are force controlled and fully backdrivable.

That means when you push on any finger, it can stop moving and tell you how hard you pushed.

Now that sounds like a little tweak, but that single change makes the hand infinitely more useful for everyday tasks.

We are witnessing the very beginning of a new age in robotics.

And just like when Roger Bannister broke the 4-minute mile, this is the hand that’ll reset the frontier for robots.
